# An optional extensible enum request body is converted to a string

## TypeSpec

```tsp
@service(#{ title: "Extensible enum request body" })
namespace ExtensibleEnumRequestBody;

union Payload {
  Foo: "foo",
  string,
}

@post
@route("/enum")
op send(@header contentType: "text/plain", @body payload?: Payload): void;
```
